description: This file defines a Java interface named ProvisioningEntriesReadPlatformService that declares methods for retrieving provisioning entries and related data in an accounting provisioning context within the org.apache.fineract project.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntriesReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for reading provisioning entries and associated data for accounting provisioning in the system.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductsProvisioningData
methods.description: Fetches provisioning data for loan products as of a specific date.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntryData
methods.description: Retrieves a provisioning entry by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Retrieves all provisioning entries with pagination support.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntryData
methods.description: Retrieves a provisioning entry by date string.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntryDataByCriteriaId
methods.description: Retrieves provisioning entry data by criteria ID.

methods.name: retrieveExistingProvisioningIdDateWithJournals
methods.description: Retrieves existing provisioning ID and date with journal entries.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Retrieves provisioning entries based on search parameters.
